card.name: The word speech as a talk given
card.fires_on: The word "speech" meaning a formal talk or address, usually after "a", "his", or a name's possessive. It appears in web text about public figures and historical events.

modes.label: A speech given somewhere
modes.description: "speech" after "a" and before a place or event, as in a speech at or in a location.
modes.example: SYDNEY – In a<< speech>> at the Center for Strategic and International Studies

modes.label: A person's named speech
modes.description: "speech" after a possessive or descriptive word, naming a particular address.
modes.example: gave clear information in his<< speech>> of 23 June 19

card.plain: It lights up on the word "speech" when it means a public address given by someone.
